# Fixtures

Three bundles under `bundles/`. Every file in them is hashed byte for byte by its `manifest.json`, so `.gitattributes` keeps git from converting line endings, and Biome and TypeScript are configured to leave this folder alone.

| Bundle | What it is | Manifest |
|---|---|---|
| `spec-example` | A verbatim copy of `bundles/acme_retail` from the Open Knowledge Format repository, https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/open-knowledge-format, at commit `25461dbcdd5b2f3fc9aef99c19fb7d8a94ef6149` (Apache-2.0; see `NOTICE`). Nineteen files: pages with `verified`, `sources` and footnotes, a deprecated page, index files, a `log.md` that carries frontmatter, a Python attester and an HTML file. Its pages carry real `stale_after` dates in 2026, so tests on it must inject the clock | Added by this repository, not part of the copy |
| `behaviours` | Twenty-four files: pages written for the tests, one per behaviour row of `docs/intent.md` section 6: provenance, lifecycle, links, derived titles and descriptions, unknown values, markup in a body, a page that gives orders, a folder the search engine would skip, an attachment. Dates use the years 2000 and 2999 so nothing expires | Yes |
| `refused` | The committed per-file refusal cases: a file with no frontmatter, a page with no `type`, frontmatter that is not YAML, an engine configuration folder, and one fine page beside them that is served regardless. The hostile cases that cannot be committed safely, a symbolic link and a path escape, are generated by the walker's tests at run time | Yes, so the fine page is served when integrity is required |
| `no-manifest` | One fine page and no manifest: the bundle-level refusal when integrity is required, and a normal load when it is not | None, by design |

The clock: core tests always pass a fixed `now` (`test/helpers/fixtures.ts` exports `NOW`); the command-line tool will read a test-only override from `OKF_CATALOG_NOW` (bite 4) so spawned tests are deterministic too. Boundary tests pass their own clock: at 2000-06-01T12:00:00Z, `beta` is overdue by a calendar-day rule but not by the instant rule its datetime calls for, and `theta`, read as UTC, is not yet overdue.

Manifests are produced by `node test/tools/make-manifest.mjs test/fixtures/bundles/<name>` until the `pack` command exists. The commit recorded in a fixture manifest is forty zeros, because fixtures do not come from a git branch. `test/unit/fixtures.test.ts` re-verifies every committed manifest.
